missions.title: ①
missions.description: "You seek peace, and you fight for a better peace."

missions.title: ②
missions.description: "I'm going in today, no matter what, and nobody's going to get in my way."

missions.title: ③
missions.description: "It was the shotgun that Light was most skilled with. He fought here."

missions.title: ④
missions.description: "The bottle is coated in a layer of dust... It belongs to the Galatea Corporation."

missions.title: ⑤
missions.description: "Please believe me, Father."

missions.title: ⑦
missions.description: "'Opportunities' mean nothing if they do not produce results. He detests people who let him down."

missions.title: ⑧
missions.description: "The only way you can stay on the case is by staying in the Stasi."

missions.title: ⑩
missions.description: "We're all prepared to fight any and all injustice to the bitter end!"

missions.title: ⑪
missions.description: "I'm a Galatea researcher. I have medicine."

missions.title: ⑫
missions.description: "The 'future' is such a vague term. At this point, Germany can only afford to focus on the present."

missions.title: ⑭
missions.description: "I am a Stasi agent and a colleague of K's. You may call me J."

missions.title: ⑮
missions.description: "Such a country is no longer the motherland that we've sacrificed everything for."

missions.title: I
missions.description: "This mission is codenamed 'Neo'. Our objective is to find a missing cargo truck."

missions.title: II
missions.description: "Don't worry... It won't be too long until our proper reunion."

missions.title: IV
missions.description: "You could do everything, so why did you defy Father?"

missions.title: V
missions.description: "The minute hands ticks in its progressing, filling J with anxiety."

missions.title: VI
missions.description: "Even now, we are still not entirely aware of our adversary's true identity."

missions.title: VIII
missions.description: "This is the first time someone has tried to hunt me..."

missions.title: IX
missions.description: "Obscured rumors, and the obscured truth."

missions.title: XI
missions.description: "It's not easy being an informant, Frau Nele."

missions.title: XII
missions.description: "The Nyto named Bramedb has finally surfaced."

missions.title: XIV
missions.description: "Those who fail have outlived their purpose. You taught me that."

missions.title: XV
missions.description: "Commander, your blood still runs hot."

missions.title: IA
missions.description: "The affection from just half a minute ago was nothing but an act."

missions.title: IIA
missions.description: "Nimogen saved my life, so I'll return the favor once."

missions.title: IVB
missions.description: "The consignee is called 'Umruss'."

missions.title: VB
missions.description: "Does Gray Elementary only take first-grade students?"

missions.title: VIB
missions.description: "I am not acting on an impulse here. This is the closest we'll ever come to solving this missing cargo case."

missions.title: IB
missions.description: "I will not do anything that will jeopardize the future of our people. Everything I do is for the State."

missions.title: IIB
missions.description: "The moment is at hand, and all characters are in position."

missions.title: IIIA
missions.description: "If we lose this shipment of weapons, none of us are going to have a good time!"

missions.title: VA
missions.description: "I remember now... You're the last T-Doll of the AR Team... "

missions.title: VIIA
missions.description: "This encounter almost feels like a journey through time and space."

missions.title: Alpha
missions.description: "She IS M4, but at the same time she isn't."

missions.title: Beta
missions.description: "Your heart once beat with compassion."

missions.title: Gamma
missions.description: "If you must go, then I'll go with you."

missions.title: Delta
missions.description: "A Paradeus unit is mopping the floor over there..."

missions.title: Epsilon
missions.description: "Ange is right here inside this plant. If we just trust her..."

missions.title: Eta
missions.description: "...Live on, J. Live on until you can avenge them."

missions.title: Iota
missions.description: "It's been her plan to lead us into a trap right from the start."

missions.title: Lambda
missions.description: "He's always making someone else pay the price in his place... Making them pay the price for his recklessness and presumption..."

missions.title: Mu
missions.description: "Perhaps it's time we have a new best friend."

missions.title: Nu
missions.description: "Today is a great and important day for Germany!"
There is a big red circled date on the calendar. Today is a day worth celebrating."
"Do not go gentle into that good night."
"Not everything you see is real. Don't rely on your eyes too much, Commander."
"It's your turn. Let me see Ange."
"Perfect timing."
"Our only hope for victory is to deliver the neural cloud servers to safety."
"Only the dead have seen the end of the war."
"Once again, Griffin's future is in our hands."

missions.title: Pico
missions.description: "The Factory is no longer just a factory, but a miniature museum. One dedicated to love, death, and robots."

missions.title: Nano
missions.description: "We will stop them here, even with just the few of us."

missions.title: Milli
missions.description: "Get up, we're all watching you from behind."

missions.title: Deci
missions.description: "It's a promise. See you in Berlin."

missions.title: Deca
missions.description: "I've brought a special consultant."

missions.title: Kilo
missions.description: "I have delivered death to your doorstep."

missions.title: Mega
missions.description: "It's my turn, dearie. —Bramedb"

missions.title: Giga
missions.description: "God, you sound like a proper Stasi."

missions.title: Tera
missions.description: "Grant to the souls of all our faithful departed your mercy, light and peace."
